provenance.instrument: East Lampeter Township Code Chapter 375 Zoning (East Lampeter Zoning Ordinance of 2016, Ord. No. 323, 5-16-2016, as amended through Ord. No. 350, 9-21-2020, and later amendments), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 code date 2025-12-15 (breadcrumb). New Laws on 2026-11-14: 'There are currently no known new laws for this Code.' The district use lists were last amended by Ord. No. 380 (8-4-2025) and Ord. No. 374 (8-5-2024).
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 breadcrumb 'Code 2025-12-15'. New Laws: none on 2026-11-14.
checks: 'Apartment as an accessory use': 'A dwelling unit for rent and/or lease that on a lot with a permitted single-family detached dwelling' (375-2020, Dwelling (8)). It is an accessory use by right with a permitted single-family detached dwelling in R-1, R-2, R-3, MU, BH, VG, VC and VR (375-23070A(2), Chart 375-23070, and each district's accessory use list). Not in AG

'No more than one apartment unit shall be permitted on a lot with a single-family use' (375-23070C(1)(b)). The section sets no floor area cap, no owner-occupancy rule and no rule on who may live there

The apartment may be inside the house, attached to it or in a separate building. A dwelling is 'A building or structure or portion thereof ... for one or more families living independently of each other' (375-2020), 375-23070C speaks of 'The building occupying the permitted principal use and the accessory apartment use', and the subdivision chapter excludes from land development the 'Construction of an apartment as an accessory use in combination with an existing single-family dwelling' (368-201, land development C(1)). That exclusion names an existing house only. Confirm the form with the Zoning Officer

R-2 and R-3 list 'Apartment as an accessory residential use to a single-family dwelling' (375-6020B(3), 375-7020B(3)) while 375-23070A(2) and the definition say a single-family detached dwelling. Whether a semidetached house qualifies is not settled
Parking: 1 space for the apartment plus 2 for the single-family dwelling, 3 in all (Table 375-22160.1)

ECHO housing is also an accessory use by right with a single-family detached dwelling in AG, R-1, R-2, R-3, MU, BH, VG, VC and VR: a temporary unit for an elderly, handicapped or disabled relative of the owners and occupants (or a caregiver), on a conforming lot, at most 2,000 sq ft of gross floor area including any garage and basement, an agreement with the Township, removal when no longer qualified, 1 parking space (375-23240, Table 375-22160.1). In AG it is the only accessory unit

Detached accessory buildings over 120 sq ft: at least 15 ft behind the front facade of the house (10 ft in BH), 25 ft high, and the district's accessory side and rear yards (375-3030C(2), 375-5030C(2), 375-6030C, 375-7030C, 375-15030E(2), 375-17030C(2), 375-18030C(3), 375-19030C(3), 375-20030C). The more restrictive setback applies where provisions conflict (375-23660C). Accessory buildings count toward building and lot coverage (375-22030B)

In VG and VC a residential accessory building 'must be unattached and may not cover an area that is larger than 50% of the principal building footprint, or 1,000 square feet of floor area, whichever is less' (375-18030C(1), 375-19030C(1)). The 50% is of the house's footprint, not its floor area. Whether an apartment in such a building is held to this cap is not said

In BH, VG, VC and VR the single-family detached lot minimum is written 'per dwelling unit' (7,500 sq ft with public sewer and water, 12,000 sq ft with public sewer and on-lot water). The apartment is a dwelling unit by definition. Whether the single-family 'per dwelling unit' lot figure also applies to it is not said. Ask the Zoning Officer
AG: a single-family attached dwelling as a second dwelling on a farm over 25 acres, for a relative of the landowner who lives in the farmhouse, is a special exception (375-3020C(11), 375-23780)

AG dwelling quota: 'For each 25 acres of contiguous land ... there may be one dwelling unit constructed upon such parent tract' (375-3040C). The farm second dwelling is exempt (375-23780C(3)). Whether an ECHO unit counts against the quota is not said. Ask the Zoning Officer

The subdivision chapter defines ECHO housing as a unit of at most 900 sq ft for a parent, grandparent or lineal descendant of the residents of the house, or their caregiver, placed to the side or rear of the house, and excludes it from land development (368-201). The zoning chapter allows up to 2,000 sq ft and any relative by blood, marriage or adoption (375-23240). A larger ECHO unit, or one for another relative, may need a land development plan. Ask the Township

Historic resources (National Register, PHMC or the Comprehensive Plan) may be adapted by conditional use for townhouses and multifamily dwellings (375-21050E(2)(k)), or for 'Other uses that are compatible with the surrounding area, to enable the preservation, restoration or rehabilitation of that property, as determined acceptable by the Board of Supervisors' (375-21050E(2)(l)). That last item may reach a second unit in a historic building. Board of Supervisors conditional use
Uses not listed are conditional uses in I-2 only (375-23850). No building or land may be used except for a permitted use (375-1090B(1))
provenance.notes: Zoning office: East Lampeter Township Zoning Officer. Read on eCode360 (EA2320) in a browser, one page at a time, on 2026-11-14. Code search (all content, New Laws included) for 'accessory apartment', 'accessory dwelling', 'in-law', ECHO, 'elder cottage', granny, 'family dwelling', relative, 'housekeeping unit', caretaker, 'tenant house', 'guest house' and 'accessory living' found the dwelling definitions (apartment as an accessory use, ECHO housing, miniature housing units), 375-23070, 375-23240 and 375-23780. A second search for 'secondary housing', 'miniature housing', 'second dwelling', 'two-family', duplex and conversion found no two-family or conversion use in the zoning chapter. 'Secondary housing unit' appears only in the miniature housing definition ('tiny houses' may be a permitted secondary housing unit, ECHO unit or manufactured home) and is not defined. Read in full: 375-23070, 375-23240, 375-23780, Articles III (AG), V (R-1), VI (R-2), VII (R-3), XV (MU), XVII (BH), XVIII (VG), XIX (VC), XX (VR), 375-22030, 375-23660, 375-21050, 375-23850, 375-22100, and the definitions of dwelling, family, dwelling unit and building coverage. Parking table rows read (375-22160). Not read: C-1, C-2, C-3, I-1, I-2 and BP use lists (the charts in 375-23070 and 375-23240 show no apartment with a single-family dwelling and no ECHO housing there), the Airport, Floodplain and Commercial Redevelopment overlays, nonconforming lots (375-24060). A township web page lists a 2026 'Ordinance to Amend Zoning Code' (PDF, not opened). eCode360 shows no New Laws, so its adoption is not known. Fix round 2026-11-14 after an independent review, each point read again in the code: internal and attached forms moved to allowed (dwelling definition, 375-23070C, 368-201 land development exclusion C(1)), AG reads ECHO housing by right, the historic conditional use 375-21050E(2)(l) added, the VG and VC 50% read as a share of the house footprint (no share cap stored), VC does not require public sewer (375-19030A(7)), lot-area-per-unit notes reworded, the AG dwelling quota (375-3040C) and the subdivision chapter ECHO definition (368-201) added as checks. Still not read: 375-25060, C-1, C-2, C-3, I-1, I-2 and BP use lists, the overlays other than the Historic Resource Overlay and 375-24060, and the R-2, R-3 and VR accessory subsections by letter.

term.note: 'A dwelling unit for rent and/or lease that on a lot with a permitted single-family detached dwelling or a permitted nonresidential use.' ECHO housing is a separate accessory use for relatives (375-2020, Dwelling (7), 375-23240).

status.note: 'An apartment as an accessory use to a permitted single-family detached dwelling shall be permitted within the R-1, R-2, R-3, MU, BH, VG, VC and VR Zoning Districts.' The chart shows it in the 'By right' row, and each district lists it among 'Accessory uses permitted by right'.

scope_districts.note: The accessory apartment reaches R-1, R-2, R-3, MU, BH, VG, VC and VR (375-23070A(2)). In AG the only accessory unit is ECHO housing, by right (375-3020B(3), 375-23240), with its own path, family rule and size cap below.

status_outside.note: C-1, C-2, C-3, I-1, I-2 and BP have no apartment with a single-family dwelling and no ECHO housing in the charts of 375-23070 and 375-23240 (their use lists were not read).

path.note: Zoning permit. Listed among the accessory uses permitted by right in each of the eight districts.

fallback_path.note: Relief from a district rule is a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board. 375-25060 was not read.

value.note: AG lists 'ECHO housing as an accessory use to a permitted single-family detached dwelling' among the accessory uses permitted by right. A temporary unit placed on the lot for an elderly, handicapped or disabled relative of the occupants, or a caregiver, at most 2,000 sq ft. Not the accessory apartment.

value.name: ECHO housing as an accessory use
value.conditions: A temporary unit placed on the lot of a single-family detached dwelling, for an elderly, handicapped or disabled person related by blood, marriage or adoption to the landowners and occupants, or a caregiver. One per conforming lot. At most 2,000 sq ft of gross floor area including any garage and basement. One family. Sewer and water capacity shown, no separate connections required. Agreement with the Township on occupancy, term and removal. Removed by the landowner as the permit or agreement says. 1 parking space.
value.note: The only accessory unit in AG. 'Shall be located on a conforming lot that complies with the land area and setback requirements of the zoning district' (375-23240D(1)).

value.name: Single-family attached dwelling as a second dwelling on a farm
value.conditions: One attached dwelling added to the farmhouse, on a farm over 25 acres. The landowner owns the farm and lives in the existing house. The attached unit is occupied by a relative of the landowner. Its own way in and out on all floors. 2 parking spaces in addition to the 2 for the house. No separate utility connections required.
value.note: A principal use by special exception. 'Located on a farm exceeding 25 acres' (1,089,000 sq ft).

value.name: Historic resource adapted for townhouses or multifamily dwellings
value.conditions: A building on the National Register, identified by the PHMC or in the Comprehensive Plan may be adapted by conditional use for 'Townhouses and multifamily dwellings'. Expert evidence that the changes keep the historic status. Area and bulk rules of the most restrictive district where the use is permitted by right.
value.note: A multifamily dwelling has three or more units (375-2020, Dwelling (3)). Not a path for one added unit.

value.name: Historic resource adapted for another compatible use
value.conditions: A building on the National Register, identified by the PHMC or in the Comprehensive Plan may be adapted by conditional use for 'Other uses that are compatible with the surrounding area, to enable the preservation, restoration or rehabilitation of that property, as determined acceptable by the Board of Supervisors'. Expert evidence that the changes keep the historic status. Area and bulk rules of the most restrictive district where the use is permitted by right.
value.note: Board of Supervisors conditional use. Whether a second dwelling unit is such a use is for the Board to decide.

zoning_districts.note: The accessory apartment in R-1, R-2, R-3, MU, BH, VG, VC and VR. In AG only ECHO housing.

building_types.note: With a permitted single-family detached dwelling. R-2 and R-3 list it as accessory 'to a single-family dwelling' (375-6020B(3), 375-7020B(3)), so a semidetached house is not settled.

historic_bypass.note: No bypass of the ADU rules. A historic resource may be adapted by conditional use for 'Other uses that are compatible with the surrounding area, to enable the preservation, restoration or rehabilitation of that property' (375-21050E(2)(l)), which may reach a second unit. It is listed with the other ways to add a unit.

requires_conforming_lot.note: 375-23070 does not tie the apartment to a conforming lot. ECHO housing needs one (375-23240D(1)).

value.condition: In AG only ECHO housing is an accessory unit: a temporary unit placed on the lot, not a unit in or attached to the house or in an existing building.

In AG (ECHO housing): occupied only by an elderly, handicapped or disabled person related by blood, marriage or adoption to the landowners and occupants of the house, or by a caregiver. Agreement with the Township, removal when no longer qualified.
In AG (ECHO housing) the lot must be a conforming lot that meets the district land area and setbacks.

types_allowed.note: 'A dwelling unit ... on a lot with a permitted single-family detached dwelling', with no form named. A dwelling is 'A building or structure or portion thereof ... for one or more families living independently of each other' (375-2020). 375-23070C speaks of 'The building occupying the permitted principal use and the accessory apartment use'. The subdivision chapter excludes from land development the 'Construction of an apartment as an accessory use in combination with an existing single-family dwelling' (368-201, land development C(1)), which names an existing house only. So a unit inside the house, attached to it or in its own building is read as allowed. In AG only a new ECHO unit.

max_sqft.note: 375-23070 sets no floor area limit for the apartment. ECHO housing: 2,000 sq ft (375-23240E(2)).

max_height_ft.note: Accessory buildings over 120 sq ft: 25 ft in every district read (12 ft for 120 sq ft or less).

front_yard_barred.note: 'The minimum front yard setback line from all streets shall be 15 feet to the rear of the front facade of the principal building' (10 ft in BH). So no detached accessory building in front of the house.

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: Each district sets its own accessory building yards. Where provisions conflict the more restrictive setback applies (375-23660C).

accessory_structure_max_sqft.note: VG and VC: a residential accessory building 'may not cover an area that is larger than 50% of the principal building footprint, or 1,000 square feet of floor area, whichever is less'. The other limit is 50% of the house's footprint, not of its floor area. The file cannot hold a share of the footprint, so only the 1,000 sq ft is stored. Check the footprint share with the Zoning Officer.

accessory_cap_binds_adu.note: 375-23070 does not say whether an apartment in an accessory building is held to this cap. Not settled.

owner_occupancy.note: No owner-occupancy rule. The unit is 'for rent and/or lease' (375-2020, Dwelling (8)).

family_only.note: Outside AG anyone may live there. In AG only ECHO housing for a relative.

occupancy.value: Outside AG any household: the apartment is a dwelling unit for rent or lease, and a family is any number of relatives or up to three unrelated people (375-2020). In AG the unit is ECHO housing, only for an elderly, handicapped or disabled relative of the occupants of the house, or a caregiver (375-23240).

max_adus.note: 'No more than one apartment unit shall be permitted on a lot with a single-family use.' One ECHO unit per lot (375-23240C(2)). Whether a lot may have both is not said.

spaces_required.note: '1 parking space for the apartment unit, plus 2 parking spaces for the permitted single-family dwelling.' ECHO housing: 1 space.

min_lot_sqft.note: With public sewer accessible. 'The minimum lot size per principal building or use shall be 22,500 square feet.' At most two acres for residential uses. Width 60 ft at the street, 100 ft at the setback line. Only ECHO housing is an accessory unit in AG.

setback_front_ft.note: Where nearby buildings are closer, the average of the adjacent buildings within 200 ft, never less than 10 ft behind the right-of-way (375-3030B(2)(b)).

principal_max_height_ft.note: Taller with 2 ft more setback per foot, up to 50 ft (375-3030D(2)).

max_building_coverage.note: Residential and agricultural uses. 17,424 sq ft on residential lots over two acres. Buildings, structures and impervious surfaces together at most 30%.

accessory_setback_side_ft.note: Detached accessory buildings over 120 sq ft: at least 15 ft behind the front facade of the house, side 20 ft, rear 6 ft, 25 ft high. On a farm a building of 120 sq ft or less may stand in front of a dwelling (375-3030C(1)(a)).

adu_max_sqft.note: Only ECHO housing is allowed in AG: 'shall not have a gross floor area in excess of 2,000 square feet, including any enclosed garage and basement area.'

value.when: With an on-lot sewage system (or where public sewer needs an extension)
value.note: 'For all uses where sanitary sewerage is provided by an individual on-lot system, the minimum lot size per dwelling unit or other principal building or use shall be 40,000 square feet.' Whether the ECHO unit counts as a dwelling unit for this is not said (375-23240D(1) asks a conforming lot that meets the district land area). Width 75 ft at the street, 125 ft at the setback line.

min_lot_sqft.note: With public sewer: 'the minimum lot size per principal building or use shall be 22,500 square feet.' Without it the lot is as large as the county or state sewage rules need, at most one acre (two along an existing public road). Width 60 ft at the street and 100 ft at the setback line with public sewer, 75 and 125 ft without.

setback_front_ft.note: Where nearby buildings are closer, the average of the adjacent buildings within 200 ft, never less than 10 ft behind the right-of-way (375-5030B(2)(b)).

principal_max_height_ft.note: Taller with 2 ft more setback per foot, up to 50 ft (375-5030D(2)).

max_building_coverage.note: Buildings. Buildings, structures and impervious surfaces together at most 40%.

accessory_setback_side_ft.note: Detached accessory buildings over 120 sq ft: at least 15 ft behind the front facade of the house, side 10 ft, rear 6 ft, 25 ft high. 120 sq ft or less: 4 ft side and rear, 12 ft high (375-5030C, E).

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached dwelling, at most 12,000 sq ft. Semidetached 6,000 sq ft per unit. All uses need public sewer and public water (375-6030A(6)). Width 50 ft at the street, 75 ft at the setback line.

setback_side_ft.note: Single-family detached. Semidetached 12 ft on the exterior side.

principal_max_height_ft.note: Taller with 2 ft more setback per foot, up to 50 ft (375-6030D(2)).

max_building_coverage.note: Buildings. Buildings, structures and impervious surfaces together at most 50%.

accessory_setback_side_ft.note: Detached accessory buildings over 120 sq ft: at least 15 ft behind the front facade of the house, side 10 ft, rear 10 ft, 25 ft high. 120 sq ft or less: 4 ft side and rear, 12 ft high.

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached dwelling, at most 12,000 sq ft. Semidetached 5,000 sq ft per unit. Width 50 ft at the street, 75 ft at the setback line.

setback_rear_ft.note: 'All residential uses within the R-3 Zoning District shall have a rear yard setback of 10 feet.'

principal_max_height_ft.note: 'The maximum height of a building or structure occupied by a principal use shall be 60 feet.' Up to 75 ft with more setback.

max_building_coverage.note: Buildings. Buildings, structures and impervious surfaces together at most 60%.

accessory_setback_side_ft.note: Detached accessory buildings over 120 sq ft: at least 15 ft behind the front facade of the house, side 10 ft, rear 10 ft, 25 ft high. 120 sq ft or less: 4 ft side and rear, 12 ft high.

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached dwelling. All uses need public sewer (375-15030A(6)). Width 50 ft.

setback_front_ft.note: Minimum 10 ft, maximum 25 ft from the right-of-way.

principal_max_height_ft.note: Up to 60 ft with 2 ft more setback per foot.

max_building_coverage.note: Buildings. Buildings, structures and impervious surfaces together at most 60%.

accessory_setback_side_ft.note: Detached accessory buildings over 120 sq ft: at least 15 ft behind the front facade of the house, side 5 ft, rear 5 ft, 25 ft high. (375-15030E(2)). 375-15030C also says accessory buildings meet 'the minimum setback requirements that are specified under 375-15030', which may mean the principal yards. Ask.

min_lot_sqft.note: '7,500 square feet per dwelling unit' for a single-family detached dwelling with public sewer and public water, at most 12,000 sq ft. All uses need public sewer. Width 50 ft. Bird-in-Hand design guidelines apply (375-17040).

principal_max_height_ft.note: Up to 50 ft with 2 ft more setback per foot.

max_building_coverage.note: Buildings. Buildings, structures and impervious surfaces together at most 80% (90% with most parking behind the front setback line).

accessory_setback_side_ft.note: Detached accessory buildings over 120 sq ft: at least 10 ft behind the front facade of the house, side 3 ft, rear 5 ft, 25 ft high (375-17030C(2), E(3)).

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: 'The minimum lot area for a single-family detached dwelling shall be 7,500 square feet per dwelling unit.' The apartment is a dwelling unit by definition (375-2020). Whether this single-family figure also applies to it is not said. Ask the Zoning Officer.

value.when: With public sewer and on-lot water
value.note: '12,000 square feet per dwelling unit' with public sewer and on-lot water, at most 40,000 sq ft. Per dwelling unit as in A(1). Public sewer is required for all uses (375-17030A(7)).

utility_rows.note: The apartment is a dwelling unit by definition. Whether the single-family per dwelling unit figure also applies to it is not said. Ask the Zoning Officer.

min_lot_sqft.note: '7,500 square feet per dwelling unit' for a single-family detached dwelling with public sewer and public water. All uses need public sewer (375-18030A(7)). Width 50 ft.

principal_max_height_ft.note: Up to 50 ft with 2 ft more setback per foot.

max_building_coverage.note: Buildings. Buildings, structures and impervious surfaces together at most 70% (80% with most parking behind the front setback line).

accessory_setback_side_ft.note: Detached accessory buildings over 120 sq ft: at least 15 ft behind the front facade of the house, side 5 ft, rear 5 ft, 25 ft high (375-18030C(3), E(3)). A residential accessory building may cover at most 50% of the house footprint (not its floor area) or 1,000 sq ft of floor area, whichever is less (375-18030C(1)).

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: '7,500 square feet per dwelling unit.' The apartment is a dwelling unit by definition (375-2020). Whether this single-family figure also applies to it is not said. Ask the Zoning Officer.

value.when: With public sewer and on-lot water
value.note: '12,000 square feet per dwelling unit' with public sewer and on-lot water facilities. Public sewer is required for all uses.

utility_rows.note: The apartment is a dwelling unit by definition. Whether the single-family per dwelling unit figure also applies to it is not said. Ask the Zoning Officer.

min_lot_sqft.note: '7,500 square feet per dwelling unit' for a single-family detached dwelling with public sewer and public water. Uses not served by public sewer must meet the Pennsylvania DEP rules (375-19030A(7)). The section gives no lot figure for a single-family dwelling without public sewer. Width 50 ft.

principal_max_height_ft.note: Up to 50 ft with 2 ft more setback per foot.

max_building_coverage.note: Buildings. Buildings, structures and impervious surfaces together at most 70% (80% with most parking behind the front setback line).

accessory_setback_side_ft.note: Detached accessory buildings over 120 sq ft: at least 15 ft behind the front facade of the house, side 5 ft, rear 5 ft, 25 ft high (375-19030C(3), E(3)). A residential accessory building may cover at most 50% of the house footprint (not its floor area) or 1,000 sq ft of floor area, whichever is less (375-19030C(1)).

value.note: '12,000 square feet per dwelling unit' with public sewer and on-lot water facilities. VC also allows uses without public sewer under DEP rules (375-19030A(7)), with no lot figure given for them.

utility_rows.note: The apartment is a dwelling unit by definition. Whether the single-family per dwelling unit figure also applies to it is not said. Ask the Zoning Officer.
